title: SuperGUM
tagline: A censorship-resistant subscription-based content sharing platform
description: This project is intended as a censorship-resistant premium-content subscription platform akin to Patreon or Onlyfans. It is not intended as an alternative to social media, but rather as a gateway to premium content which is easy to create and share for anyone with an Ethereum wallet.
how_its_made: The foundation of the project is React.js with create-react-app. All storage is taken care of by Moralis. All fund streaming business is taken care of by Superfluid. The current frontend is running on Skynet Homescreen, which I made the mistake of only integrating at the very end (rather than trying out earlier). The instance running on the Demo link doesn't work properly when Ethereum addresses are called via URL, but I am sure there has to be a way to fix that. I had a plan of how I wanted to build this project and I'm glad that I was able to get it all done in such a short amount of time, given my level of experience.
